question: The human shoulder joint is an example of a _____ joint.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ball and socket.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The human shoulder joint is an example of a** ball and socket joint.**
 
• A ball and socket joint is a natural or manufactured joint or coupling in which a partially spherical end lies in a socket, allowing multi-directional movement and rotation. 
 
• This allows** flexion, extension, adduction, abduction, and rotation.**
